name: Humility
source:
[spoiler]Sister of Pride, she is the spirit sealed in the sacred sword of the same name.[/spoiler]
Whenever the protagonist fails in saying the name of the voice inside of him, she would sacrifice herself along with Kindness to alllow him to travel back and grating him one more chance.
